summary: Completed e2e testing of Vendor Price Comparison feature. All 11 test features verified - Backend GET /api/prices/vendor-comparison endpoint returns items with vendor prices sorted by latest_price ascending (cheapest first), best_vendor field correctly identifies lowest price vendor, savings_pct calculated correctly. Frontend shows 'Vendor Price Comparison' section below Items table with 11 comparison cards, each card displays vendor rows with: vendor name, latest price, date, unit, purchase count. Best price vendor row highlighted green with 'BEST PRICE' badge. Savings percentage badge shown on cards where savings > 0%. Filter input works correctly. Single-vendor items (Test Item) do NOT show BEST PRICE badge. All existing Items page functionality still works: search, Add Item, Edit, Delete, Manage Aliases, Price History.
seed_data_creation: Existing demo data used - ~43 purchases across 5 vendors, 10 canonical items with aliases, 11 items appear in vendor comparison with 1 single-vendor item (Test Item)

Frontend VendorComparison component renders below Items table with filter input, cards grid, vendor rows sorted cheapest first with green highlight and BEST PRICE badge on best vendor (only for multi-vendor items).
